# Vercel agent skills

These files are verbatim copies from [vercel-labs/agent-skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills)
at commit `1a2c79d4e6c4a2283dc2c614b6538cbe1ed5ca62`.

What was taken:

- From `react-best-practices/rules/`, only names starting with `async-`, `bundle-`, `client-`,
  `rerender-`, `rendering-`, `js-` or `advanced-`: 60 files.
- From `composition-patterns/rules/`, all 10 files.

Nothing else was taken. Never edit these rule files. To update, copy the files from a newer
commit and change the commit here. [docs/react.md](../../react.md) is emend's summary; the full
rule texts are here.
